highlights: Package checks take one machine-wide check slot, reuse a stable checkout and the build cache declared in .zodchi/verify.json, and refuse before any model call when declared tools are missing. Agent writers get writerEnv and a shared writer cache.
Finished runs remove their writer workspaces; zodchi flow cleanup lists and removes old candidates, journals, claims and dev builds, keeping every journal a claim or pending application still uses.
Research and incident-triage refuse model answers only for real secrets, incident reads cut large output and can be retried with --rerun "read <id>", and ops-script repairs only script defects.
